pages.text: Incident log. A multiblock whose containment reaches zero does not simply stop. What it was holding gets out - and what gets out depends on the machine. I have catalogued five kinds.

$(li)$(thing)Reality Destabilisation$() (colliders, reactors, forges, crucibles): a blast, and the surrounding world starts to come apart. Blocks become $(thing)Fractured Reality$(): they fade in and out and split into smaller copies of themselves, spreading slowly before reality heals.

Anything alive suffers too. Creatures caught in Fractured Reality glitch and splinter like the shadows of higher-dimensional bodies, hit harder and move faster. Villagers and zombies become $(thing)Destabilised Husks$(). I learned that one at a cost.

$(li)$(thing)Spatial$() (singularities, wormholes, universe forging): a $(thing)rupture$() grows for ten seconds, drags everything in, eats the terrain and detonates. $(thing)Void Wraiths$() - tiny living black and white holes - crawl out, and burst like a creeper when they collapse. Hawking would have been delighted. I was not.

$(li)$(thing)Infectious$() (Matrioshka Brain, Reality Compiler, Assembly Line): flying $(thing)Nanite Swarms$() escape. They split when destroyed, down to single units, and any creature that dies infected bursts into a new swarm. Grey goo, in other words - the old nanotech nightmare, given wings.

$(li)$(thing)Temporal$() (Causality Loop Engine): $(thing)Paradox Echoes$() - walking clockwork, one for every player nearby - that rewind themselves when hurt.$(li)$(thing)Dimensional$() (Rift, Tesseract, Breach, Omnilex): a rupture plus $(thing)Law Wraiths$(), broken laws of nature shaped like tesseracts.

Note to self: overclocked machines fail harder. Keep containment up with a $(item)Field Calibrator$(), or install an $(item)Autonomous Calibrator$().$(br2)For server owners: the consequences or the block damage can be disabled in the config, and block damage also respects the $(thing)mobGriefing$() game rule.
A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().
What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.$(br2)Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().
Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.$(br2)Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
